text:
This is still the easiest way to connect Grok @bot to a phone number

However there are 2 options.

1. Pay for a dedicated number, get unlimited text and calls

https://x.ai/bot/Z7LfRtBtwfaojaomMrAuX

2. Connect to Bland API and use the free credits, and be able to only make outbound calls from a different number every time
https://x.ai/bot/kTIbHezzQ-FNbcJ85zBBc
